v: Chunky Panday scary ga kanipisthe movie something special ani ardham 😂 Bold, raw, terrific performances... and Vidya is absolutely the BEGUM JAAN 🙏
e: Begum Jaan worked for me through sheer emotional force rather than conventional action. The rustic writing, excellent performances and powerful music create goosebumps without needing elaborate stunt sequences, while Vidya Balan dominates the centre and even Chunky Panday becomes genuinely frightening. Its boldness may limit the family audience, but the impact is undeniable.
body:
watched #BegumJaan ….. you know that you are watching a Great Movie when even Chunkey Pandey gets a meatier role and man he is full scary as Kabir…

and what a superb movie it is full of bold emotions and rustic dialoges with Top notch BGM and excellent acting from each n every artist….._/\_

You dont need great stunts or action episodes it all takes great dialoges and superb music to create scenes which give goosebumps….

and Man…..if Kangana is called the Queen of Bollywood then Vidya is her Begum Jaan!!!!!!!

Not sure about the comercial success of the movie as the so called family audience may not watch the so called bold content…..but will surely create an impact on the audience.

PS : I havent watched the original bengali version

v: One ticket konna... THREE movies free ga vachayi 😭😂 Srinu Vaitla multithreading screenplay + three climaxes... 2h40m somehow felt like 10 hours.
e: Mister left me wondering how Varun Tej agreed to the film and convinced that Srinu Vaitla had not escaped the formula he was expected to change. Characters and subplots keep arriving without purpose, the second half becomes exhausting and the climax itself seems to multiply — a sprawling commercial mess rather than a coherent entertainer.
body:
Watched #Mister …..
Tag line manam prema ni vethukuntu velthe preme manalni vethukuntu vasthundi but cinema original tag line meeru oka cinema ni chudalani ticket tesukunte vasthey 3 cinemalu mimalni ethukuntu vasthayi _/\_

assalu ee cinema ni Varun Tej ella opukunaado guda artham kavatledhu…..Srinu Vaytla maarademo anukoni cinema chudaniki ellina vaalaki eedu manam chachinaa maradu anee namakam balanga vasthundi

assalu anni char’s endhuku vasthayo theledhu vaalu em cheyali anukunaaro theledhu….aaalatho vaytla babu em cheyisdham anukunaado theledhu….its just rajiv udyogasri padhakam for all telugu char artists

assalu 2nd half lo aa Krishna Devaraya Vamsam episodes Highlight….2 hrs 40 mins movie ee 10 hrs nuncho chusthunaa feeling vasthundi……Climax epudepudda ani aassa ga edhuru chuse valaki 3 climaxes chusi raktha kaaneeree _/\_

naaku thelisi Vaytla ki chinapati nunchi Java Multi Threading Concept ante mozu anukuntaaa andhuke aaadhe format follow ayipothuntaadu cinema after cinema

v: Expectations ni basement lo petti vellandi 😄 Story marchipondi, songs appudu eyes + ears close cheyyandi... PK okkade ee cheap-looking package ni somehow carry chesthadu.
e: Katamarayudu felt like a storyline that belonged in the 2000s filmed with visual effects from the 1990s. Pawan Kalyan’s screen presence and Ajay’s expressions are almost the only positives I found, while the music, BGM, supporting material and exaggerated performance choices make the entire package feel surprisingly cheap for a star vehicle.
body:
ipudosthunaaa out of box cinemalu chusi, ekkuva expect cheyakunda……story gurunchi pedhaga patijchukokundaaa…..Shruthi Hassan unnapudu kallu musukoni……patallu vachinapudu kalla tho paatu chevulu musukogaluguthe….cinema bavuntundi

2000’s lo teyalsina story line ki 1990 CG work tho tesina movie….The only saving grace for the movie is Power star supported by Ajay’s expressions and worst/irritating part is Anup Rubens Music & BGM amplified by Shruthi Hassan’s Over Expressions

Oka Rayudoooo BGM music bit thapaaa music is horrible…..manodiki inko star hero movie music kotali ante atleast 10 years wait cheyalemoo

PK okadini petesukoni……migithaaa Story, Support Cast, Music, Shruthi’s make up anni thegaaa cheapuuuu gaa santhalo konatunnaru _/\_

v: Dowry + women independence meeda good point... commercial treatment motham confuse chesindi 😐 Neither strong message movie nor proper entertainer. And title Vaidehi Ka Dulha kada? 😄
e: Badrinath Ki Dulhania starts from themes I found worthwhile and realistic, especially dowry and the expectations placed on women. Varun Dhawan does justice to the Jhansi tapori and Alia Bhatt is effortless, but the commercial packaging repeatedly weakens the material until the film sits awkwardly between social drama and mainstream entertainer without fully succeeding as either.
body:
#BadrinathkiDulhania : I do generally start speaking about only good points of the movie, but I cannot hold back myself from being LOL of the pathetic reality that the whole plot of movie revolves around Women Empowerment and against the Dowry system and how the Mard Varun becomes a real hero under the guidance of Alia, then why the hell the movie is named Badrinath ki Dulhania Vaidehi Ka Dulha should have been apt title for the movie.

These are the small points which prove that we are still in male dominated industry and the words like women empowerment are just to preach!!! way to go Dharma Productions and KoJo _/\_

Story deals with Dowry and Women Empowerment…..many may feel the movie’s story and screenplay is someting out from the 90’s. But thats what still happens in many places/families in India.

Kudos to Varun Dhawan for choosing this subject. Varun has clearly done justification to the good tapori from Jhansi. It has been a cakewalk for Alia, nothing much to challange the potential of the lill dynamite.

The plot of the movie is excellent but the way it is dealt in complete commercial manner has played a spoil sport. At the end of the day you neither get a feeling of watching a great story oriented movie nor a pakka commercial entertainer.

If you watch the movie for its realistic story line, the way it has been dealt will make you feel pathetic and if you watch it as a pakka commercial film then the story line looks pathetic
